sources.landCover: ESA WorldCover 10 m v200 (2021), CC BY 4.0, resampled to 5 m by nearest neighbour
sources.wetGrid: scripts/make_wetgrid.py, 450 mm rainfall, level-pool allocation, Priority-Flood conditioned surface
sources.buildings: Open3dhk 3D Tiles footprints fused with Overture Maps 2026-09-23.0

warning: Every footprint here is a candidate parcel read from land cover and the wet grid at 5 m. None is a surveyed site with an owner, a boundary agreement or a works programme. Sites are screening-level: run them and read the ledger.

projects.name: Underground tank

projects.source: derived from landclass_hsk.npy (paved class) minus the Open3dhk/Overture building footprints
projects.confidence: screening: the impervious extent is measured; a tank of this size has never been priced
